start.text:
The coastal village of Port Sapphire buzzes with rumor: a massive earthquake has shifted the seabed, revealing the entrance to the legendary Sunken Temple of Thalassia — an ancient civilization's greatest temple, lost beneath the waves for millennia.

Scholar Mirelle has hired you to explore the temple and recover the Heart of Thalassia — a gemstone of immense power. She warns: 'The temple was sealed for a reason. The Thalassians worshipped a sea god... and some say their guardian still patrols those halls.'

choices.text: Dive into the temple entrance at low tide
Ask Mirelle about the guardian she mentioned
Visit the docks to hire a boat for deep access
Search the shore for other entrances exposed by the earthquake

guardian_lore.text: Mirelle reads from an ancient text: 'The Leviathan Guardian — a construct of coral and enchanted bronze — was built to protect the Heart. It responds to the temple's wards. But there are control altars throughout the temple. If you can deactivate three of them, the Guardian should power down.'

choices.text: Dive in and look for control altars
Hire a boat for better access

boat_hire.text: Captain Vex, a weathered sailor, agrees to take you out. 'I know these waters. There's a deeper entrance on the temple's east side — less rubble, more direct to the inner chambers.' She gives you a waterproof lantern and a breathing talisman that creates air bubbles.

shore_found.text: Behind a collapsed cliff face, you find a secondary entrance — a ceremonial gate with Thalassian inscriptions. This leads to the upper temple galleries, bypassing the flooded lower halls.

shore_nothing.text: The shoreline is treacherous — sharp rocks and strong currents. You find nothing useful.

entrance.text:
You wade into the temple entrance. The water is knee-deep, flowing over beautifully tiled floors depicting sea creatures. Bioluminescent algae provides an eerie blue-green light.

The entrance hall branches into three corridors: left (decorated with warriors), center (decorated with priests), and right (decorated with craftsmen).

deep_entrance.text: The deep entrance leads directly into a grand chamber — the temple's main hall. Enormous coral pillars rise from the water, and ancient mosaics cover the walls. A control altar glows faintly at the far end.

gallery.text:
The upper gallery overlooks the temple's main hall from above. You can see the layout: three control altars (in the warrior hall, priest quarters, and craftsman workshop), all connected to a central sanctum where the Heart of Thalassia rests on a pedestal.

A massive shape moves in the flooded lower level — the Leviathan Guardian, slowly patrolling.

choices.text: Descend to the warrior hall to find the first altar
Drop down to the priest quarters
Try to reach the sanctum directly from above

warrior_hall.text:
The warrior hall is a training ground. Ancient weapon racks line the walls — most corroded, but you spot a bronze trident that still gleams. In the center, the first control altar glows blue.

Two animated coral statues guard it, their empty eyes tracking your movement.

choices.text: Try to sneak past them to the altar

trident.text: You grab the trident — it hums with ancient enchantment! With this weapon, the coral guardians should be easier to handle.

choices.text: Attack the guardians with the trident!

coral_win.text: The coral guardians shatter! The altar is yours.

coral_hurt.text: A coral fist catches you hard. You smash the guard apart but feel the bruise forming.

altar1.text:
You place your hand on the control altar. Ancient Thalassian text glows: 'First ward — deactivated.' The altar goes dark. One of three.

Somewhere in the temple, you hear a deep mechanical groan — the Leviathan Guardian has slowed, weakened.

choices.text: Head to the priest quarters for the second altar
Go to the craftsman workshop for the second altar

priest_hall.text:
The priest quarters are serene — meditation pools, prayer alcoves, and shelves of waterlogged scrolls. The second altar sits in a chapel, protected by a magical ward — a shimmering barrier of water.

Nearby, a puzzle mechanism on the wall shows tidal symbols.

choices.text: Solve the tidal puzzle to lower the barrier

puzzle_solved.text: You rotate the tidal symbols to match the phases of the moon. The water barrier collapses silently. The second altar awaits.

puzzle_fail.text: Wrong sequence — the mechanism zaps you with a jolt of arcane energy! You try again with shaking hands and get it right.

barrier_broken.text: With brute force, you shatter the water barrier. It explodes in a spray of enchanted mist.

barrier_shock.text: The barrier electrifies you as you force through! Painful but effective — you're on the other side.

altar2.text:
'Second ward — deactivated.' Another groan echoes through the temple. The Guardian is significantly weakened. One more altar to go.

The water level in the temple has risen slightly — the earthquake's effects are ongoing. You need to hurry.

choices.text: Rush to the craftsman workshop — last altar
Go directly to the sanctum and face the weakened Guardian

craft_hall.text: The craftsman workshop contains ancient forges and workbenches. The third altar stands in the center — unguarded, but the floor around it is a trap: pressure plates connected to bronze harpoon launchers in the walls.

choices.text: Trigger the traps from a distance and wait them out

plates_hit.text: A harpoon grazes your leg as you misstep! You reach the altar but you're bleeding.

altar3.text:
'Third ward — deactivated. All wards offline.' A massive crash echoes through the temple — the Leviathan Guardian has collapsed, powered down. The path to the sanctum is clear!

But the water is rising faster now. You have minutes.

choices.text: Rush to the sanctum for the Heart of Thalassia!

sanctum_sneak.text: You try to drop down to the sanctum...

sanctum_early.text: You drop into the sanctum — but the Guardian senses you! With all three wards active, it's at full power.

choices.text: Fight the Guardian at full strength!

guardian_alert.text: You fall from above and the crash alerts the Leviathan Guardian. It surges toward you!

choices.text: Run to deactivate the altars first!

sanctum_fight.text: The Leviathan Guardian rises before you — fifteen feet of coral, bronze, and ancient magic. Even weakened, it's formidable.

choices.text: Look for a weakness in its construction

guardian_down.text: With a final, shattering blow, the Leviathan Guardian collapses into a pile of coral and bronze. The sanctum falls silent.

guardian_hard.text: The Guardian hammers you with a coral fist. Pain explodes through your body. But you find its weak point — a glowing core in its chest — and strike it. The construct topples.

choices.text: Grab the Heart and escape the rising water!

sanctum_clear.text:
The sanctum is a magnificent domed chamber. At its center, on a coral pedestal, rests the Heart of Thalassia — a sapphire the size of your fist, pulsing with oceanic power.

The water is at your waist and rising. No time for reverence.

heart_taken.text:
As you lift the Heart, the temple shudders. Ancient mechanisms groan. The water surges. The earthquake-damaged structure is collapsing!

You sprint through rising water, the Heart clutched to your chest. The way you came is flooding fast.

choices.text: Look for an emergency exit — ancient temples always have one

swim_escape.text: You swim through the flooding halls...

emergency_exit.text: You search for another way out...

close_escape.text: The current slams you against a wall. You barely hold onto the Heart. With lungs burning, you find the exit and burst into sunlight.

choices.text: Gasp for air on the surface

victory.text:
You break the surface, gasping, the Heart of Thalassia glowing brilliantly in your hand. Behind you, the temple entrance collapses in a cascade of bubbles, sealed once more beneath the waves.

Captain Vex hauls you aboard her boat. 'Stars above — you actually got it!'

Back in Port Sapphire, Scholar Mirelle holds the Heart with trembling hands. 'This changes everything. The knowledge of Thalassia... the power of the ancient seas... we'll study it for generations.'

She pays your fee — and then some. 'You've just made archaeological history, my friend.'

As you watch the sunset over the harbor, the sapphire glints one last time. Somewhere deep below, the temple rests in its watery grave, its secret finally shared with the world above.
